description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class LDAPAuthProvider used in the LDAP authentication plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates user distinguished name (DN) and user ID information.

classes.name: LDAPAuthProvider
classes.description: A PHP class representing LDAP authentication provider data, encapsulating user DN and user ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes LDAPAuthProvider with user DN and user ID.

methods.name: getUserDN
methods.description: Returns the distinguished name (DN) of the LDAP user.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the LDAP user.
